title: NIST WebBook: Acetic acid is C2H4O2, molecular weight 60.0520 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Acetic acid as C2H4O2, molecular weight 60.0520 amu, CAS 64-19-7.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Acetic acid, CAS Registry Number 64-19-7, lists molecular formula C2H4O2 and molecular weight 60.0520 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 60.0211294 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C2H4O2/c1-2(3)4/h1H3,(H,3,4). The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
